inference_requires_only_these_repo_files.note: 250 m region stack + native-grid climate; built by build_runtime
Model 1 polygons.geojson + suitability.tif (current-class input; if absent a documented stand-in map is used)

not_in_repo_needed_only_to_retrain_or_re.what: WoSIS 2023-12 snapshot (zip 456 MB, extracted TSVs ~2.2 GB)
Hassani et al. 2020 measured ECe/ESP point shapefiles (zips 2.6 MB + 9.6 MB, extracted ~160 MB)
not_in_repo_needed_only_to_retrain_or_re.rebuild: download ECe_input_training_data.zip and ESP_input_training_data.zip, unzip to ece_train/ and esp_train/

not_in_repo_needed_only_to_retrain_or_re.what: Global feature layers: SoilGrids 1 km (phh2o, clay, sand, soc; 5-15 cm mean; ~0.68 GB), WorldClim 2.1 5-arcmin bioclim zip (180 MB), WorldClim 30-arcsec elevation zip (338 MB); total ~1.6 GB
Shared covariate cache written by model1 (SoilGrids 250 m, Copernicus DEM, TerraClimate raw 2011-2020), ~1.1 GB
TerraClimate region npz built from the shared cache

rebuild_order: python -m models.restoration.soilml            # trains + writes checkpoints and eval/soil_models_report.json
